column1: Artificial Intelligence is transforming education. Schools and universities are using AI tools to improve personalized learning. These tools help students understand difficult concepts. AI also helps teachers automate grading and track student progress. However excessive dependence on AI may reduce independent thinking. Experts believe AI should support teachers rather than replace them.
column2: AI is transforming education through personalized learning and teacher assistance. However it should support rather than replace teachers.

column1: A university opened a research centre focused on renewable energy storage. Researchers will study battery recycling and grid-scale storage. The centre will collaborate with local companies and provide student research opportunities.
column2: A university established a renewable energy centre to research battery recycling and energy storage while collaborating with companies and students.

column1: A hospital introduced an online appointment system. Patients can book appointments and receive reminders. The system is expected to reduce waiting times. Phone bookings will remain available for patients who cannot use the internet.
column2: A hospital launched online appointments and reminders to reduce waiting times while retaining phone booking options.

column1: A coastal town restored wetlands near its harbour. The wetlands provide habitats for birds and absorb storm water. Volunteers and scientists will monitor plant growth and water quality.
column2: A coastal town restored wetlands to support wildlife and absorb storm water. Volunteers and scientists will monitor the restoration.

column1: A public library launched digital skills classes for older adults. Weekly sessions cover email, online safety, video calls and government services. Participants can use their own devices or library computers.
column2: A library introduced digital skills classes for older adults covering communication, online safety and access to services.

column1: A farming cooperative installed soil moisture sensors on participating farms. The sensors send readings to a dashboard to help farmers decide when to irrigate. The cooperative will compare water use and crop yields.
column2: A farming cooperative is testing soil sensors to improve irrigation decisions and measure water use and crop yields.

column1: A railway operator added real-time platform updates to its mobile application. The feature displays platform changes and service delays. Station announcements will continue to be available.
column2: A railway application now provides real-time platform and delay updates while retaining station announcements.

column1: A nonprofit organization opened a community kitchen serving low-cost meals. Local restaurants donate surplus ingredients and volunteers prepare meals. The organization will track demand to plan opening hours.
column2: A nonprofit community kitchen provides affordable meals using donated ingredients and volunteer support.

column1: A technology company published a report about remote work. Employees valued flexible schedules but reported collaboration and isolation challenges. The report recommended clearer communication and opportunities for in-person interaction.
column2: A company report found that remote workers value flexibility but face collaboration and isolation challenges.

column1: A regional museum introduced audio guides in five languages. Visitors can use their phones or borrow devices. The museum expects the guides to improve accessibility and plans to collect visitor feedback.
column2: A museum launched multilingual audio guides to improve exhibition accessibility and collect visitor feedback.
